title: Modifying the Default DNS Control Rule

blocks.text: The DNS Control policy has a default rule that allows all DNS traffic. The default rule always maintains the lowest precedence. You can modify its actions, but you cannot delete or duplicate it.
To modify the default DNS Control rule:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Policy > DNS Forwarding.
Navigate to the default rule and click the Edit icon.
Under Action, from the Network Traffic drop-down menu, select an option for the default rule.
Allow: Allows DNS requests and responses that match the rule.
Block: Silently blocks all DNS requests and responses that match the rule.

Resolved by ZPA: Requests the Cloud or Branch Connector to resolve DNS requests using the IP pool. In the IP Pool field, you can select the default ZPA IP pool or any other IP pool from the drop-down menu.
Redirect Request: Redirect all DNS requests and responses to a DNS gateway.
DNS Gateway: Select a DNS gateway where requests are redirected. This option appears only when you select Redirect Request.
Click Save and activate the change.
